{{Top|leg}}
The '''Farr family''', natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], were supporters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and its [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] native [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], and staunchly opposed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The family included sisters [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn]] and [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]], both of whom fought in and survived the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
